title: Additive Predictive Value of the Sepsis ImmunoScore ® : A Multicenter, Prospective Evaluation of AI-Enabled Prediction of Sepsis Risk and Patient Outcomes
summary: The Sepsis ImmunoScore learned from a prospective three-system cohort added predictive information beyond clinician assessment for Sepsis-3 and related outcomes.
organization: Affiliations not stated in the reviewed primary metadata

evidence.tested: In 401 patients the preprint reports AUROC 0.83 versus 0.68 for the comparator; this is an observational prediction result and does not establish treatment benefit.
evidence.unknown: The reviewed source does not establish prospective benefit, broad external validity, or replication beyond the reported study.
evidence.ai_role: Sepsis ImmunoScore enabled the stated case-specific result.

source_review.scope: Primary result-bearing material for the stated method, result and evaluation, with bibliographic version information.
